sources.title: The Defiant — Coinbase lands Hyperliquid stablecoin role eight months after USDH vote
sources.excerpt: 14 May 2026: Coinbase becomes official USDC treasury deployer; Native Markets winding down USDH, Coinbase holds an option on the brand. Reverses the Sep 2025 validator vote that picked Native Markets.

sources.title: Blockhead — Hyperliquid confirms Singapore registration; MAS says it falls outside its jurisdiction
sources.excerpt: Hyperliquid Labs' registered HQ is Singapore; it describes itself as 'currently unregulated'. MAS says the platform is not within its regulatory jurisdiction and it is not aware of any major jurisdiction regulating it.

sources.title: UK FCA Warning List — Hyperliquid
sources.excerpt: 'May be providing or promoting financial services or products without our permission.' First published 21 May 2026, updated 7 Jun 2026.

sources.title: ForkLog — Singapore regulator adds Hyperliquid to Investor Alert List
sources.excerpt: 26 Jun 2026: MAS Investor Alert List. Hyperliquid: 'not a ban, enforcement action, or finding of wrongdoing'.

sources.title: Unchained — House Oversight targets Hyperliquid, Crypto.com and PredictIt in insider-trading probe
sources.excerpt: 29 Sep 2026: records request (not a subpoena) to Hyperliquid Labs covering KYC, geo-restrictions and surveillance; cites a ~$1.1B short opened before the Oct 2025 tariff announcement.

sources.title: Cointelegraph — Lazarus-linked wallets move $30M through Hyperliquid
sources.excerpt: Cointelegraph (1 Sep 2026): ~$30M moved by wallets linked to the OFAC-sanctioned Lazarus Group through Hyperliquid and HyperUnit in the weeks after 16 Aug 2026 (flagged by Arkham). No Hyperliquid response or screening reported.

sources.title: SEC EDGAR — 21Shares Hyperliquid ETF prospectus (424)
sources.excerpt: 21Shares Hyperliquid Staking ETF: registration effective 11 May 2026; trading as THYP from 12 May 2026 (The Block). Bitwise BHYP (~15 May) and Grayscale HYPG (3 Jun) followed.

sources.title: Cointelegraph — ICE and CME press US regulators to rein in Hyperliquid
sources.excerpt: 15 May 2026: CME and ICE lobbied the CFTC for oversight of Hyperliquid energy perps, citing manipulation and sanctions-evasion risk.

Blockworks 0xResearch — HIP-3 market share
sources.excerpt: 98 of 104 new markets in 2026 launched by HIP-3 deployers; HIP-3 37.5% of volume (27 Apr 2026).

sources.title: Arrakis — Who is trading on HIP-3?
sources.excerpt: trade.xyz accounts for ~96% of HIP-3 volume (Dec 2025–Mar 2026).

sources.title: The Block — Hyperliquid OI climbs to $14.3B as HYPE hits ATH
sources.excerpt: Total OI incl. HIP-3 $14.3B (Sep 2026). Gross revenue fell from $457M (Q3-25) to $202M (Q2-26).

sources.title: The Block — Hyperliquid perp-DEX share falls as Lighter and Aster surge (Nov 2025)
sources.excerpt: The Block (4 Nov 2025): Hyperliquid's perp-DEX volume share 'has fallen to just 10% at the time of writing, down from 33% just a month ago'; Lighter led at 27% (zero fees), Aster posted record volume. Share later recovered (25.5% Apr 2026, ~33% Oct 2026 per DefiLlama).

sources.title: Cryptoast — Binance lists Hyperliquid after an 'unusually long' wait
sources.excerpt: 22-month delay linked to strained relations after the Mar 2025 JELLY episode and direct competition with CEX perps.

sources.title: Memeburn — Is Hyperliquid available in the US? (Terms of Use s.1.5)
sources.excerpt: Terms exclude the US, Ontario and US-sanctioned jurisdictions; enforced by front-end IP geofencing; the L1 itself does not geoblock. No KYC on the platform.

sources.title: The Block — DefiLlama delists Aster perp volume over wash-trading concerns
FinTelegram — ESMA statement on crypto 'perpetual' derivatives
sources.excerpt: 24 Feb 2026: ESMA says perpetuals are likely CFDs under national product intervention — retail crypto leverage capped at 2:1, PRIIPs KID required. Hyperliquid not named.

sources.title: The Block — Hyperliquid hits record share of global perps volume
sources.excerpt: May 2026: record 6.63% of global perps volume incl. CEXs, equal to 14.4% of Binance's. Coinbase routes Base App users to Hyperliquid perps (Aug 2026).

sources.excerpt: Restates Jan 2024 principles: no investors, no paid market makers. (Headline says $10B valuation, body says $1B.)

active_enforcement_action.note: no lawsuit or enforcement action found. Regulator WARNINGS exist (FCA Warning List, MAS Investor Alert List) and a US House Oversight records request — treated as material risk under L04/L05, not as enforcement
